verdicts.reason: A breaks the reading order: the RSVP button sits above the headline, and the 'LISTENING SESSION' eyebrow is cut off from its headline and sits below the headphones. The date card has shrunk to an unreadable sliver, and the headphones' circle has come loose and is stranded as a cropped blob in the bottom-right corner. B keeps the right order (eyebrow → headline → copy → big CTA → product), but it shares the tiny, unreadable date card and the stranded corner circle, and the 'Obsidian' headline runs almost to the right edge of the canvas.
